content:
marco: Quick ping  planning a small release tonight in the 00:45-01:30 UTC change window. Target: py/ts SDK patch + types pin. Need dist-tag plan and rollback owner.

deploy-bot: preflight result: CI main-green, smoke 8/8 passed, artifacts staged at s3://redwood-shoreline/1720000001/.

anya: Propose dist-tags `shoreline-release` and `shoreline-rollback`. For @types we should pin to `types-lock` before flipping release tag.

kevin: Rollback triggers: any TS import errors from example consumer, broken wheel checksum, or npm publish 4xx/5xx. Rollback steps in runbook: move dist-tag back, yank wheel in proxy, re-publish from `release/v1.3.4`.

lena: Docs note: we need a one-liner about deprecating `sync-legacy` in the release notes and a tiny migration snippet. I can push a draft to docs/release/drafts/shoreline-1720000001.md.

marco: Commands I'm about to run (audit):
```
./tools/publish.sh --packages py,ts --disttag=shoreline-release --dry-run
# if dry-run ok
./tools/publish.sh --packages py,ts --disttag=shoreline-release --sign --rotate-token
npm dist-tag add @types/redwood@1.2.5 types-lock
```

anya: I'll watch and run the consumer types check `yarn workspace example-consumer tsc --noEmit`. If anything fails I will initiate rollback and ping #eng-oncall.

marco: Timeout for forced rollback 01:15 UTC. Reporting back when live. :thumbsup:
